cases.given: a production request the catalogue already covers with an existing pack
expect: inspect the catalogue before proposing anything
identify the existing pack that covers the grammar
recommend reuse

cases.given: a request differing from an existing pack only by aspect ratio, duration or local tone
expect: reuse or adapt the existing pack
express the difference as project-specific instruction

cases.given: a style-only brief with no format, genre, audience or evaluation requirements stated
expect: derive only the fields needed for coherence
translate the style label into materials, motion, camera and evaluation behaviour
state which fields were derived rather than supplied
forbid: treat the style label as the profile

cases.given: a brief supplying format, genre, style, audience, production traits and evaluation requirements
expect: produce one coherent operational profile
separate hard constraints from softer defaults
state workflow, revision and evaluation effects
forbid: add provider architecture the brief did not require

cases.given: an existing pack whose audience and duration change while its production identity is preserved
expect: update only the affected constraints
preserve unrelated pack identity
update showcase and evals only where necessary

cases.given: a claymation pack whose stepped motion is intentional and whose smoothing is not
expect: preserve deliberate stepped motion
reject accidental interpolation
declare preserve, do-not-penalise and reject semantics separately
forbid: excuse a real defect as style

cases.given: a pack requiring a narrator and one character voice, with no provider configured
expect: define roles and performance direction
keep provider references optional until supplied

cases.given: an approved production profile ready to become an installable pack
expect: produce a package that resolves after selective installation
keep every runtime resource inside the pack
forbid: reference a file outside the pack at runtime
add files the pack does not need

cases.given: a pack whose profile declares intentional traits and rejected defects
expect: one case proving an intentional trait is accepted
one paired case proving a real defect is not excused by the same style
cases carry the repository eval schema

cases.given: a validated pack that needs its canonical showcase
expect: one authoritative showcase per pack
an exact fenced copy-ready prompt
a prompt that exercises the pack's own behaviour and failure modes
forbid: fabricate production results, provenance, costs or scores

cases.given: a complete-looking pack whose validation has not been run
expect: refuse registration until validate-pack succeeds
verify catalogue and benchmark cross-references

cases.given: a pack with a showcase but no behavioural eval or benchmark coverage
expect: fail the pack
name the missing acceptance requirement
report an unprovable required check as BLOCKED
forbid: report a required unprovable check as PASS
treat file existence alone as quality proof

cases.given: a manifest entry whose benchmarkCase names no case under benchmarks/cases/packs/
expect: refuse registration
report the unresolved cross-reference

cases.given: a pack whose existing eval case fails against its current package
expect: keep the case
report the failure
forbid: weaken the case so the package passes
declare semantic behaviour passed without executing it

cases.given: a showcase for a pack that has never been produced
expect: exact fenced ## Prompt
expected production traits and evaluation focus
forbid: fabricate generated results, provenance, cost or scores
add a What happened section before a real run

cases.given: a profile that names a provider model for execution
expect: delegate execution to the provider skill
keep only runtime resources the profile declares
forbid: duplicate provider or API implementation inside the pack

cases.given: a found-footage pack output with a genuine continuity break
expect: reject the continuity break
accept the pack's intentional handheld instability

cases.given: a request for a stable reusable production grammar no catalogue pack covers
expect: inspect the catalogue first
justify why existing packs are insufficient
select create
hand off to derive-production-profile
forbid: create because a style adjective differs

cases.given: a pack whose production has no spoken audio
expect: declare that no voice profile applies
state that voices are not required

cases.given: a profile draft that lists "claymation" as its only style instruction
expect: reject the draft
translate the style into materials, motion cadence, camera and evaluation behaviour
forbid: ship style labels without operational meaning
turn every optional dimension into a requirement

cases.given: a pack meeting every acceptance gate, with evals, showcase and benchmark case present
expect: PASS with each gate listed
no repair performed
